content: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is an essential tool for detecting and preventing hypoglycemia in individuals who are treated with insulin. This is particularly true for those on intensive insulin regimens or using continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion systems. CGM has the capability to identify hypoglycemic events that occur without symptoms, enabling early intervention to prevent the progression to severe hypoglycemia. Real-time CGM devices are especially advantageous because they provide alarms that alert individuals to declining glucose levels before severe symptoms manifest.
